Atlantic Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 800 AM EDT Tue Oct 20 2026
Regardless of the status of the system, high winds, coastal
flooding, and dangerous surf are expected along portions of the U.S. East Coast during the next few days. E. Pacific Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 500 AM PDT Tue Oct 20 2026
South of Southern Mexico (EP94):
A low-pressure system located a few hundred miles south of the Gulf of Tehuantepec is producing a large area of showers and thunderstorms that are gradually becoming better organized, and a tropical depression is forecast to form during the next day or so. This system is expected to move westward to west-northwestward at around 10 mph during the next few days, remaining well offshore of southern Mexico.
